propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts at lines 249–250 in test_llm_fallback_chain.py due to URL prefix checks via startswith() that permit substring-sharing hosts to pass

The assertions compare URL base_url against a hardcoded endpoint constant using startswith, which would incorrectly accept a malicious host like https://fallback.test.evil.example/ that shares the prefix
The assertions must be replaced with exact equality comparison of parsed URL origins (scheme, netloc tuple) via urllib.parse.urlsplit to eliminate both the CodeQL alert and the weak test logic

The endpoint constant must be single-sourced so the configured and asserted values cannot drift, preserving the test's ability to detect fallback models built against the provider default instead of the configured endpoint
